children.translated_text: if they are approved even while carrying on the transaction.

children.text: kṣetrādīṇāṃ tathaiva syur bhrātā bhrātṛsutaḥ sutaḥ
children.translated_text: In the same way, for fields and the like, a brother, brother's son, or son may act,

children.text: nisṛṣṭāḥ kṛtyakaraṇe guruṇā yadi gacchatā ||
children.translated_text: if, when the elder is going away, they have been authorized to perform the business.

children.text: nisṛṣṭārthas tu yo yasmin tasminn arthe prabhus tu saḥ
children.translated_text: The one assigned to a particular matter is master in that matter;

children.text: tadbhartā tatkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ nānyathā kartum arhati ||
children.translated_text: his principal is not entitled to alter the business done by him.

children.text: sutasya sutadārāṇāṃ vaśitvaṃ tv anuśāsane
children.translated_text: Authority over a son and over the son's wives is only in discipline;

children.text: vikraye caiva dāne ca vaśitvaṃ na sute pituḥ ||
children.translated_text: in sale and gift, however, a father has no authority over a son.

children.text: śuddhis tu śāstratattvajñaiś cikitsā samudāhṛtā
children.translated_text: Purification, by those who know the true meaning of the treatise, is declared to be a remedy;

children.text: prāyaścittaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca tābhyāṃ sā dvividhā smṛtā ||
children.translated_text: through expiation and through a fine, it is remembered as twofold.

children.text: anekārthābhiyoge 'pi yāvat saṃsādhayed dhanī
children.translated_text: Even in a suit concerning many sums, whatever amount the creditor establishes,

children.text: sākṣibhis tāvad evāsau labhate sādhitaṃ dhanam ||
children.translated_text: that much proven money he obtains through witnesses.

children.text: sarvāpalāpaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā mitho 'lpam api saṃvadet
children.translated_text: After making a denial of everything, if the accused privately admits even a little,

children.text: sarvam eva tu dāpyaḥ syād abhiyukto bṛhaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: he should be made to pay all of it, says <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: evaṃ dharmāsanasthena samenaiva vivādinā
children.translated_text: Thus, by one seated on the seat of <s>dharma</s> and impartial toward the litigants,

children.text: kāryāṇāṃ nirṇayo dṛśyo brāhmaṇaiḥ saha nānyathā ||
children.translated_text: the decision of cases should be examined together with Brahmins, and not otherwise.

children.text: vyavahārān svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrutvā vā prāḍvivākataḥ
children.translated_text: After the king has seen legal proceedings himself, or has heard them from the <s>prāḍvivāka</s>,

children.text: jayapatraṃ tato dadyāt parijñānāya pārthivaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he should then give a victory document for recognition.

children.text: rājā tu svāmine vipraṃ sāntvenaiva pradāpayet
children.translated_text: The king should make a Brahmin pay his creditor by conciliation alone;

children.text: deśācāreṇa cānyāṃs tu duṣṭān saṃpīḍya dāpayet ||
children.translated_text: but according to local custom he should make others pay, and the wicked after applying pressure.

children.text: rikthinaṃ suhṛdaṃ vāpi chalenaiva pradāpayet
children.translated_text: He may make an heir or even a friend pay by stratagem;

children.text: vaṇijaḥ karṣakāṃś cāpi śilpinaś cābravīd bhṛguḥ ||
children.translated_text: and likewise merchants, farmers, and artisans, said <s>Bhṛgu</s>.

children.text: dhanadānāsahaṃ buddhvā svādhīnaṃ karma kārayet
children.translated_text: Knowing that he is unable to pay money, one should make him perform work under one's own control;

children.text: aśaktau bandhanāgāraṃ praveśyo brāhmaṇād ṛte ||
children.translated_text: if he is incapable even of that, he is to be put into prison, except in the case of a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>.

children.text: karṣakān kṣatraviśśūdrān samīhānāṃs tu dāpayet ||
children.translated_text: Farmers, <s>kṣatriyas</s>, <s>vaiśyas</s>, and <s>śūdras</s> who have the means, however, should be made to pay.

children.text: ācāryasya pitur mātur bāndhavānāṃ tathaiva ca
children.translated_text: With regard to a teacher, father, mother, and likewise relatives,

children.text: eteṣām aparādheṣu daṇḍo naiva vidhīyate ||
children.translated_text: when these commit offences, no <s>daṇḍa</s> (penalty) at all is prescribed.

children.text: prāṇātyaye tu yatra syād akāryakaraṇaṃ kṛtam
children.translated_text: But where an improper act has been done when life was at risk,

children.text: daṇḍas tatra tu naiva syād eṣa dharmo bhṛgusmṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: there should be no penalty there; this is the <s>dharma</s> remembered by <s>Bhṛgu</s>.

children.text: na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt sarvapāpeṣv avasthitam
children.translated_text: One should never kill a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, even when he is involved in every crime;

children.text: rāṣṭrāc cainaṃ bahiḥ kuryāt samagradhanam akṣatam ||
children.translated_text: rather, one should expel him from the kingdom with all his wealth intact.

children.text: caturṇām api varṇānāṃ prāyaścittam akurvatām
children.translated_text: For all four <s>varṇas</s> who do not perform expiation,

children.text: śarīradhanasaṃyuktaṃ daṇḍaṃ dharmyaṃ prakalpayet ||
children.translated_text: one should impose a lawful penalty involving both body and property.

children.text: yena doṣeṇa śūdrasya daṇḍo bhavati dharmataḥ
children.translated_text: For the offence for which a penalty lawfully applies to a <s>śūdra</s>,

children.text: tena cet kṣatraviprāṇāṃ dviguṇo dviguṇo bhavet ||
children.translated_text: for <s>kṣatriyas</s> and <s>brāhmaṇas</s> it should become doubled successively.

children.text: pravrajyāvasitaṃ śūdraṃ japahomaparāyaṇam
children.translated_text: A <s>śūdra</s> who has entered renunciation and is devoted to recitation and oblation

children.text: vadhena śāsayet pāpaṃ daṇḍyo vā dviguṇaṃ damam ||
children.translated_text: should be punished as a wrongdoer with death, or else he is punishable by twice the fine.

children.text: sarveṣu cāparādheṣu puṃso yo 'rthadamaḥ smṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: In all offences, whatever monetary fine is prescribed for a man,

children.text: tadardhaṃ yoṣito dadyur vadhe puṃso 'ṅgakartanam ||
children.translated_text: women should pay half of that; where a man would be killed, a limb is to be cut off.

children.text: nāsvatantrāḥ striyo grāhyāḥ pumāṃs tatrāparādhyati
children.translated_text: Women who are not independent are not to be seized; the man is at fault there.

children.text: prabhuṇā śāsanīyās tā rājā tu puruṣaṃ nayet ||
children.translated_text: They are to be disciplined by their master, but the king should bring the man to justice.

children.text: proṣitasvāmikā nārī prāpitā yady api grahe
children.translated_text: Even if a woman whose master is away has been placed under arrest,

children.text: tāvat sā bandhane sthāpyā yāvat pratyāgataḥ prabhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: she should be kept in confinement until the master has returned.

children.text: kalpito yasya yo daṇḍas tv aparādhasya yatnataḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever penalty has been carefully fixed for a given offence,

children.text: paṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ tu syāt tanmūlyaṃ vātha rājani ||
children.translated_text: there should be taking of that number of <s>paṇas</s>, or else its equivalent value, for the king.

children.text: māṣapādo dvipādo vā daṇḍo yatra pravartitaḥ
children.translated_text: Where a fine of a quarter <s>māṣa</s> or two quarters is imposed,

children.text: anirdiṣṭaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ māṣakaṃ tu prakalpayet ||
children.translated_text: if it is unspecified, it should be understood and reckoned as a <s>māṣaka</s>.

children.text: yatrokto māṣakair daṇḍo rājataṃ tatra nirdiśeta
children.translated_text: Where a fine is stated in <s>māṣakas</s>, one should specify it in silver;

children.text: kṛṣṇalaiś coktam eva syād uktadaṇḍaviniścayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and when it is stated in <s>kṛṣṇalas</s>, that is the determination of the stated fine.

children.text: māṣo viṃśatibhāgas tu jñeyaḥ kārṣāpaṇasya tu
children.translated_text: A <s>māṣa</s> should be known as the twentieth part of a <s>kārṣāpaṇa</s>;

children.text: kākaṇī tu caturbhāgā māṣakasya paṇasya ca ||
children.translated_text: a <s>kākaṇī</s>, however, is a quarter of a <s>māṣaka</s>, and the <s>māṣaka</s> a quarter of a <s>paṇa</s>.

children.text: pañcanadyāḥ pradeśe tu saṃjñeyaṃ vyavahārikī
children.translated_text: In the region of the Five Rivers, however, the practical terminology should be recognized:

children.text: kārṣāpaṇoṇḍikā jñeyās tāś catasras tu dhānakaḥ
children.translated_text: the <s>uṇḍikās</s> are to be known as <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>; four of them make a <s>dhānaka</s>,

children.text: te dvādaśa suvarṇās tu dīnāraś citrakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: twelve of those make a <s>suvarṇa</s>, while the <s>dīnāra</s> is remembered as the <s>citraka</s>.

children.text: asat sad iti yaḥ pakṣaḥ sabhyair evāvadhāryate
children.translated_text: The position that something is invalid or valid is to be determined by the assessors alone;

children.text: tīritaḥ so 'nuśiṣṭas tu sākṣivākyāt prakīrtitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when it has been decided and directed, it is declared on the basis of witness testimony.

children.text: kulādibhir niścite 'pi santoṣaṃ na gatas tu yaḥ
children.translated_text: But if someone is not satisfied, even after a matter has been decided by the family court and the like,

children.text: vicārya tat kṛtaṃ rājā kukṛtaṃ punar uddharet ||
children.translated_text: the king should examine it and either uphold what was properly done or overturn what was wrongly done.

children.text: na strībhyo dāsabālebhyaḥ prayacchet kvacid uddhṛtam
children.translated_text: One should never hand over recovered property to women, slaves, or minors;

children.text: dātā na labhate tat tu tebhyo dadyāt tu yad vasu ||
children.translated_text: for the payer does not obtain credit for that; only property that belongs to them should be given to them.

children.text: ṛṇikena tu yā vṛddhir adhikā saṃprakalpitā
children.translated_text: But any higher interest that has been fixed by agreement with the debtor,

children.text: āpatkālakṛtā nityaṃ dātavyā kāritā tu sā
children.translated_text: if it was made in a time of distress and was duly caused to be made, must always be paid;

children.text: anyathā kāritā vṛddhir na dātavyā kathaṃcana ||
children.translated_text: interest made otherwise is not to be paid in any way.

children.text: ekāntenaiva vṛddhiṃ tu śodhayed yatra carṇikam
children.translated_text: Where one pays off only the interest, and nothing else,

children.text: pratikālaṃ dadāty eva śikhāvṛddhis tu sā smṛtā ||
children.translated_text: giving it at each appointed time, that is known as <s>śikhāvṛddhi</s> (crest-interest).

children.text: gṛhāt toṣaḥ phalaṃ kṣetrād bhogalābhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Enjoyment from a house is called satisfaction, and produce from a field is called the gain from use.

children.text: ādhibhogas tv aśeṣo yo vṛddhis tu parikalpitaḥ
children.translated_text: But when there is complete enjoyment of a pledge and interest has been stipulated,

children.text: prayogo yatra caivaṃ syād ādhibhogaḥ sa ucyate ||
children.translated_text: where the transaction is made in this way, that is called enjoyment of a pledge.

children.text: yo yācitakam ādāya tam adattvā diśaṃ vrajet
children.translated_text: If someone takes a borrowed item and, without returning it, goes away to another region,

children.text: ūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarāt tasya taddhanaṃ vṛddhim āpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: after a year that property of his should accrue interest.

children.text: kṛtvoddhāram adattvā yo yācitas tu diśaṃ vrajet
children.translated_text: If someone, having made a borrowing, and though asked, goes away to another region without giving it back,

children.text: ūrdhvaṃ māsatrayāt tasya taddhanaṃ vṛddhim āpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: after three months that property of his should accrue interest.

children.text: svadeśe 'pi sthito yas tu na dadyād yācitaḥ kvacit
children.translated_text: But one who, even while staying in his own country, does not give when asked,

children.text: taṃ tato 'kāritāṃ vṛddhim anicchantaṃ ca dāpayet ||
children.translated_text: should then be made to pay even unwillingly the interest that was not stipulated.

children.text: prītidattaṃ na vardheta yāvan na pratiyācitam
children.translated_text: What was given out of affection does not increase so long as it has not been asked back;

children.text: yācyamānam adattaṃ ced vardhate pañcakaṃ śatam ||
children.translated_text: if, when it is being demanded, it is not returned, it increases by five per hundred.

children.text: nikṣiptaṃ vṛddhiśeṣaṃ ca krayavikrayam eva ca
children.translated_text: A deposit, an outstanding balance of interest, and a purchase or sale,

children.text: yācyamānam adattaṃ ced vardhate pañcakaṃ śatam ||
children.translated_text: if not returned when demanded, increase by five per hundred.

children.text: paṇyaṃ gṛhītvā yo mūlyam adattvaiva diśaṃ vrajet
children.translated_text: If someone takes merchandise and goes to another region without paying the price,

children.text: ṛtutrayasyāpariṣṭāt taddhanaṃ vṛddhim āpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: after three seasons that money should accrue interest.

children.text: carmasasyāsavadyūte paṇyamūlye ca sarvadā
children.translated_text: On leather, grain, liquor, gambling, and the price of merchandise, always,

children.text: strīśulkeṣu na vṛddhiḥ syāt prātibhāvyāgateṣu ca ||
children.translated_text: as also on bride-price and on what has come through suretyship, there should be no interest.

children.text: grāhyaṃ syād dviguṇaṃ dravyaṃ prayuktaṃ dhanināṃ sadā
children.translated_text: Property lent out by creditors may always be collected up to double the principal;

children.text: labhate cen na dviguṇaṃ punar vṛddhiṃ prakalpayet ||
children.translated_text: if he does not obtain the double amount, he may calculate interest again.

children.text: maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ suvarṇarajatasya ca
children.translated_text: For jewels, pearls, coral, gold, and silver,

children.text: tiṣṭhati dviguṇā vṛddhiḥ phālakaiṭāvikasya ca ||
children.translated_text: the interest remains double, and likewise for <s>phālakaiṭāvika</s> goods.

children.text: tailānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ madyānām atha sarpiṣām
children.translated_text: For all oils, liquors, and clarified butter,

children.text: vṛddhir aṣṭaguṇā jñeyā guḍasya lavaṇasya ca ||
children.translated_text: interest should be known as eightfold, and likewise for molasses and salt.

children.text: kupyaṃ pañcaguṇaṃ bhūmis tathaivāṣṭaguṇā matā
children.translated_text: Base-metal goods may be fivefold; land is likewise considered eightfold.

children.text: sadya eveti vacanāt sadya eva pradīyate ||
children.translated_text: Because the wording is "immediately," it is to be paid immediately.

children.text: ekāhe likhitaṃ yat tu tat tu kuryād ṛṇaṃ samam
children.translated_text: Whatever is written on a single day should be treated as an equal debt;

children.text: grahaṇaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ lābham anyathā tu yathākramam ||
children.translated_text: otherwise, taking, preservation, and profit are to be handled in their proper order.

children.text: nānarṇasamavāye tu yad yat pūrvakṛtaṃ bhavet
children.translated_text: But when there is a combination of several debts, whichever one was contracted earlier,

children.text: tat tad evāgrato deyaṃ rājñaḥ syācchrotriyād anu ||
children.translated_text: that very one should be paid first; the king's claim comes after that of a <s>śrotriya</s>.

children.text: yasya dravyeṇa yat paṇyaṃ sādhitaṃ yo vibhāvayet
children.translated_text: If someone establishes that particular merchandise was procured with his property

children.text: tad dravyam ṛṇikenaiva dātavyaṃ tasya nānyathā ||
children.translated_text: That money must be paid by the debtor himself, and not otherwise.

children.text: dravyaṃ gṛhītvā vṛddhyarthaṃ bhogayogyaṃ dadāti cet
children.translated_text: If, after receiving money for the sake of interest, he gives something fit for use,

children.text: jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ vāpi bhogyādhiḥ sa tu kathyate
children.translated_text: whether movable or immovable, that is called a <s>bhogyādhi</s> (usufructuary pledge).

children.text: mūlyaṃ tadādhikaṃ dattvā svakṣetrādikam āpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: By paying the corresponding value with the increase, he may recover his own field and the like.

children.text: ādhim ekaṃ dvayor yas tu kuryāt kā pratipad bhavet
children.translated_text: If someone makes one pledge to two persons, what rule should apply?

children.text: tayoḥ pūrvakṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ tatkartā coradaṇḍabhāk ||
children.translated_text: Of the two, the one made earlier is to be accepted; the maker incurs the penalty for theft.

children.text: ādhānaṃ vikrayo dānaṃ lekhyasākṣyakṛtaṃ yadā
children.translated_text: When pledging, sale, or gift has been made by document and witnesses,

children.text: ekakriyāviruddhaṃ tu lekhyaṃ tatrāpahārakam ||
children.translated_text: a document that conflicts with that single transaction is fraudulent there.

children.text: anirdiṣṭaṃ ca nirdiṣṭam ekatra ca vilekhitam
children.translated_text: When an unspecified and a specified item are written together in one document,

children.text: viśeṣalikhitaṃ jyāya iti kātyāyano 'bravīt ||
children.translated_text: the one written with particular specification is stronger, so <s>Kātyāyana</s> said.

children.text: yo 'vidyamānaṃ prathamam anirdiṣṭasvarūpakam
children.translated_text: If someone first pledges what is not present and whose form is not specified,

children.text: ākāśabhūtam ādadhyād anirdiṣṭaṃ ca tad bhavet
children.translated_text: a thing as insubstantial as space, that should count as unspecified.

children.text: yad yat tadāsya vidyeta tad ādiṣṭaṃ vinirdiśet ||
children.translated_text: Whatever of his property is then present, he should designate that as the specified item.

children.text: yas tu sarvasvam ādiśya prāk paścān nāmacihnitam
children.translated_text: But if someone first assigns all his property and later pledges an item marked by name,

children.text: ādadhyāt tat kathaṃ na syāc cihnitaṃ balavattaram ||
children.translated_text: how could that not stand? The marked item is the stronger claim.

children.text: maryādācihnitaṃ kṣetraṃ grāmaṃ vāpi yadā bhavet
children.translated_text: When a field or even a village is marked by boundaries,

children.text: grāmādayaś ca likhyante tadā siddhim avāpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: and villages and the like are written down, then it attains legal validity.

children.text: ādhīkṛtaṃ tu yat kiṃcid vinaṣṭaṃ daivarājataḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever has been given as a pledge and is destroyed by fate or by royal action,

children.text: tatra ṛṇaṃ sodayaṃ dāpyo dhaninām adhamarṇakaḥ ||
children.translated_text: in that case the debtor is to be made to pay the creditor the debt with interest.

children.text: na ced dhanikadoṣeṇa nipated vā mriyeta vā
children.translated_text: If, through no fault of the creditor, it collapses or dies,

children.text: ādhim anyaṃ sa dāpyaḥ syād ṛṇān mucyeta narṇikaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he should be made to provide another pledge; the debtor is not released from the debt.

children.text: akāmam ananujñātam adhiṃ yaḥ karma kārayet
children.translated_text: If someone makes a pledge do work unwillingly and without permission,

children.text: bhoktā karmaphalaṃ dāpyo vṛddhiṃ vā labhate na saḥ ||
children.translated_text: the user is to be made to pay the fruit of that work, or he does not receive interest.

children.text: yas tv ādhiṃ karma kurvāṇaṃ vācā daṇḍena karmabhiḥ
children.translated_text: If someone harasses a pledge while it is working, by words, a rod, or actions,

children.text: pīḍayed bhartsayec caiva prāpnuyāt pūrvasāhasam ||
children.translated_text: and also threatens it, he incurs the first <s>sāhasa</s> (amercement).

children.text: balād akāmaṃ yatrādhim anisṛṣṭaṃ praveśayet
children.translated_text: Where one forcibly sets to work an unwilling pledge that has not been released for use,

children.text: prāpnuyāt sāhasaṃ pūrvam ādhātā cādhim āpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: he incurs the first <s>sāhasa</s> fine, and the pledger recovers the pledge.

children.text: ādhiṃ duṣṭena lekhyena bhuṅkte yam ṛṇikād dhanī
children.translated_text: When a creditor enjoys a pledge from a debtor by means of a defective document,

children.text: nṛpo damaṃ dāpayitvā ādhilekhyaṃ vināśayet ||
children.translated_text: the king, after making him pay a fine, should annul the pledge document.

children.text: ādhātā yatra na syāt tu dhanī bandhaṃ nivedayet
children.translated_text: Where the pledger is not present, the creditor should report the bond.

children.text: rājñas tataḥ sa vikhyāto vikreya iti dhāraṇā
children.translated_text: Once it has then been publicly proclaimed by the king, the rule is that it may be sold.

children.text: savṛddhikaṃ gṛhītvā tu śeṣaṃ rājanyathārpayet ||
children.translated_text: After taking the amount with interest, he should then hand over the remainder to the king.

children.text: dānopasthānavādeṣu viśvāsaśapathāya ca
children.translated_text: In claims concerning gifts and attendance, and also for trust and oath,

children.text: lagnakaṃ kārayed evaṃ yathāyogaṃ viparyaye ||
children.translated_text: he should have a <s>lagnaka</s> (attached bond) made in this way, as appropriate, also in the contrary case.

children.text: darśanapratibhūryas taṃ deśe kāle na darśayet
children.translated_text: A surety for appearance who does not produce that person at the proper place and time

children.text: nibandham āvahet tatra daivarājakṛtād ṛte ||
children.translated_text: incurs the bond there, except when the failure is caused by fate or by the king.

children.text: naṣṭasyānveṣaṇārthaṃ tu deyaṃ pakṣatrayaṃ param
children.translated_text: For searching for one who is lost, at most three fortnights should be granted.

children.text: yady asau darśayet tatra moktavyaḥ pratibhūr bhavet ||
children.translated_text: If he produces him within that period, the surety should be released.

children.text: kāle vyatīte pratibhūr yadi taṃ naiva darśayet
children.translated_text: When the time has passed, if the surety does not produce him at all,

children.text: sa tam arthaṃ pradāpyaḥ syāt prete caivaṃ vidhīyate ||
children.translated_text: he is to be made to pay that amount; the same rule is prescribed when the man has died.

children.text: gṛhītvā bandhakaṃ yatra darśane 'sya sthito bhavet
children.translated_text: Where, after taking a bond, a man stands surety for producing this person,

children.text: vinā pitrā dhanaṃ tasmād dāpyaḥ syāt tad ṛṇaṃ sutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the son should be made to pay that debt from his wealth when the father is absent.

children.text: yo yasya pratibhūs tiṣṭhed darśanāyeha mānavaḥ
children.translated_text: Whatever man stands as surety here for another person’s appearance,

children.text: adarśayan sa taṃ tasmai prayacchet svadhanād ṛṇam ||
children.translated_text: if he does not produce him, he must pay that man’s debt from his own property.

children.text: ādyau tu vitathe dāpyau tatkālāveditaṃ dhanam
children.translated_text: The first two, when their undertaking proves false, are to be made to pay the money declared at that time.

children.text: uttarau tu visaṃvāde tau vinā tatsutau tathā ||
children.translated_text: But in the case of the latter two, when there is breach of agreement, their sons too are liable, except for those two cases.

children.text: ekacchāyāśrite sarvaṃ dadyāt tu proṣite sutaḥ
children.translated_text: A son living under the same roof should pay the whole when the father is abroad.

children.text: mṛte pitari pitṛaṃśaṃ pararṇaṃ na bṛhaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the father has died, he should pay the father’s share, not another’s debt, says <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: ekacchāyāpraviṣṭānāṃ dāpyo tas tatra dṛśyate
children.translated_text: Among those who have entered under one roof, he is seen to be liable there.

children.text: proṣite tatsutaḥ sarvaṃ pitraṃśaṃ tu mṛte sutaḥ ||
children.translated_text: When the father is abroad, his son pays the whole; when he is dead, the son pays the father’s share.

children.text: prātibhāvyaṃ tu yo dadyāt pīḍitaḥ pratibhāvitaḥ
children.translated_text: A surety who, being pressed, pays what he has guaranteed

children.text: tripakṣāt parataḥ so 'rthaṃ dviguṇaṃ labdhum arhati ||
children.translated_text: is entitled, after three fortnights, to recover that amount doubled.

children.text: yasyārthe yena yad dattaṃ vidhinābhyarthitena tu
children.translated_text: For whose sake, by whom, and whatever has been given after due request according to rule,

children.text: sākṣibhir bhāvitenaiva pratibhūs tat samāpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: when it has been established by witnesses, the surety may recover that very amount.

children.text: satyaṃkāravisaṃvāde dviguṇaṃ pratidāpayet
children.translated_text: On breach of a <s>satyaṃkāra</s> (earnest agreement), he should be made to repay double.

children.text: akurvatas tu taddhāni satyaṃkāraprayojanam ||
children.translated_text: For one who does not perform, loss of that deposit is the purpose of the <s>satyaṃkāra</s>.

children.text: kuṭumbārtham aśaktena gṛhītaṃ vyādhitena vā
children.translated_text: A debt taken for the sake of the family by one who is unable or ill,

children.text: upaplavanimitte ca vidyād āpatkṛte tu tat ||
children.translated_text: and also on account of a calamity, should be known as a debt made in emergency.

children.text: kanyāvaivāhikaṃ caiva pretakārye ca yatkṛtam
children.translated_text: What is incurred for a daughter’s marriage, and what is incurred for funeral rites,

children.text: etat sarvaṃ pradātavyaṃ kuṭumbena kṛtaṃ prabhoḥ ||
children.translated_text: all this, when done for the master of the household, must be paid by the family.

children.text: ṛṇaṃ putrakṛtaṃ pitrā na deyam iti dharmataḥ
children.translated_text: A debt incurred by a son is not to be paid by the father according to <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: deyaṃ pratiśrutaṃ yat syāt yac ca syād anumoditam ||
children.translated_text: What has been promised, however, is payable, as is whatever has been approved.

children.text: proṣitasyāmatenāpi kuṭumbārtham ṛṇaṃ kṛtam
children.translated_text: Even without the consent of one who is abroad, a debt incurred for the sake of the family

children.text: dāsastrīmātṛśiṣyair vā dadyāt putreṇa vā bhṛguḥ ||
children.translated_text: by slaves, women, a mother, pupils, or by a son should be paid, says <s>Bhṛgu</s>.

children.text: bhartrā putreṇa vā sārdhaṃ kevalenātmanā kṛtam
children.translated_text: A debt of this kind, contracted together with the husband or son, or by herself alone,

children.text: ṛṇam evaṃvidhaṃ deyaṃ nānyathā tatkṛtaṃ striyā ||
children.translated_text: is payable; a debt contracted by a woman in any other way is not.

children.text: martukāmena yā bhartrā proktā deyam ṛṇaṃ tvayā
children.translated_text: A woman whom her dying husband has told, “The debt must be paid by you,”

children.text: aprapannāpi sā dāpyā dhanaṃ yady āśritaṃ striyām ||
children.translated_text: is to be made to pay it even if she did not assent, if the wealth has come into the woman’s possession.

children.text: vidyamāne 'pi rogārte svadeśāt proṣite 'pi vā
children.translated_text: Even when he is living but afflicted by disease, or is abroad from his own country,

children.text: viṃśāt saṃvatsarād deyaṃ ṛṇaṃ pitṛkṛtaṃ sutaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: after twenty years a debt incurred by the father must be paid by the sons.

children.text: vyādhitonmattavṛddhānāṃ tathā dīrghapravāsinām
children.translated_text: In the case of the diseased, the insane, the aged, and those long absent,

children.text: ṛṇam evaṃvidhaṃ putrāñ jīvatām api dāpayet ||
children.translated_text: sons should be made to pay such debts even while those fathers are alive.

children.text: sāṃnidhye 'pi pituḥ putrair ṛṇaṃ deyaṃ vibhāvitam
children.translated_text: Even in the father’s presence, a debt that has been proved must be paid by the sons

children.text: jātyandhapatitonmattakṣayaśvitrādirogiṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when he is congenitally blind, fallen, insane, consumptive, afflicted with white leprosy, or the like.

children.text: pitṝṇāṃ sūnubhir jātair dānenaivādhamād ṛṇāt
children.translated_text: Since fathers are released from the debtor's debt only by payment made by sons who have been born,

children.text: vimokṣas tu yatas tasmād icchanti pitaraḥ sutān ||
children.translated_text: therefore fathers desire sons.

children.text: nāprāptavyavahāreṇa pitary uparate kvacit
children.translated_text: When the father has died, the debt is never to be paid by one who has not yet attained legal competence,

children.text: kāle tu vidhinā deyaṃ vaseyur narake 'nyathā ||
children.translated_text: but in due time it must be paid according to rule; otherwise they would dwell in hell.

children.text: aprāptavyavahāraś cet svatantro 'pīha narṇabhāk
children.translated_text: If a person has not attained legal competence, even if independent here, he does not share in the debt.

children.text: svātantryaṃ hi smṛtaṃ jyeṣṭhe jyaiṣṭhe guṇavayaḥkṛtam ||
children.translated_text: For independence is remembered as belonging to the eldest, a seniority produced by merit and age.

children.text: yad dṛṣṭaṃ dattaśeṣaṃ vā deyaṃ paitāmahaṃ tu tat
children.translated_text: A grandfather's debt that was witnessed, or a remainder left after payment, is to be paid.

children.text: sadoṣaṃ vyāhataṃ pitrā naiva deyam ṛṇaṃ kvacit ||
children.translated_text: But a debt that is defective or was repudiated by the father is never to be paid.

children.text: pitrā dṛṣṭam ṛṇaṃ yat tu kramāyātaṃ pitāmahāt
children.translated_text: The debt that was acknowledged by the father and has come down in succession from the grandfather,

children.text: nirdoṣaṃ noddhṛtaṃ putrair deyaṃ pautrais tu tadbhṛguḥ ||
children.translated_text: if faultless and not discharged by the sons, is to be paid by the grandsons, says <s>Bhṛgu</s>.

children.text: paitāmahaṃ tu yat putrair na dattaṃ rogibhiḥ sthitaiḥ
children.translated_text: A grandfather's debt that was not paid by the sons because they were afflicted by illness,

children.text: tasmād evaṃvidhaṃ pautrair deyaṃ paitāmahaṃ samam ||
children.translated_text: such a grandfather's debt is therefore to be paid equally by the grandsons.

children.text: ṛṇaṃ tu dāpayet putraṃ yadi syān nirupadravaḥ
children.translated_text: One should make a son pay a debt if he is free from impediment,

children.text: draviṇārhaś ca dhuryaś ca nānyathā dāpayet sutam ||
children.translated_text: fit in respect of wealth, and capable of bearing the burden; otherwise one should not make the son pay.

children.text: yad deyaṃ pitṛbhir nityaṃ tadabhāve tu taddhanāt
children.translated_text: What must always be paid by the fathers, in their absence, should be paid from their property.

children.text: tad dhanaṃ putraputrair vā deyaṃ tatsvāmine tadā ||
children.translated_text: That property must then be given by the sons or grandsons to its owner.

children.text: pitrarṇe vidyamāne tu na ca putro dhanaṃ haret
children.translated_text: When a father's debt exists, the son should not take the property for himself.

children.text: deyaṃ taddhanike dravyaṃ mṛte gṛhṇaṃs tu dāpyate ||
children.translated_text: The property is to be given to that creditor; if he takes it after the father's death, he is made to pay.

children.text: putrābhāve tu dātavyam ṛṇaṃ pautreṇa yatnataḥ
children.translated_text: In the absence of a son, the debt must be carefully paid by the grandson.

children.text: caturthena na dātavyaṃ tasmāt tad vinirvartate ||
children.translated_text: It is not to be paid by the fourth descendant; from him that liability ceases.

children.text: prātibhāvyāgataṃ pautrair dātavyaṃ na tu tatkvacit
children.translated_text: A debt arising from suretyship is never to be paid by grandsons.

children.text: putreṇāpi samaṃ deyam ṛṇaṃ sarvatra paitṛkam ||
children.translated_text: But a paternal debt is everywhere to be paid in the same way even by the son.

children.text: rikthahartrā ṛṇaṃ deyaṃ tadabhāve ca yoṣitaḥ
children.translated_text: A debt is to be paid by the taker of the inheritance; in his absence, by the women,

children.text: putraiś ca tadabhāve 'nyai rikthabhāgbhir yathākramam ||
children.translated_text: and in their absence by the sons and by other sharers in the inheritance, in due order.

children.text: yāvan na paitṛkaṃ dravyaṃ vidyamānaṃ labhet sutaḥ
children.translated_text: So long as a son has not obtained existing paternal property,

children.text: susamṛddho 'pi dāpyaḥ syāt tāvan naivādhamarṇikaḥ ||
children.translated_text: even if he is very prosperous, he is not to be made liable as a debtor.

children.text: likhitaṃ muktakaṃ vāpi deyaṃ yat tu pratiśrutam
children.translated_text: What has been promised as payable, whether written or unsecured by a document, must be paid.

children.text: parapūrvastriyai yat tu vidyāt kāmakṛtaṃ nṛṇām ||
children.translated_text: But what is owed to a woman formerly belonging to another should be known as a debt made by men from desire.

children.text: yatra hiṃsāṃ samutpādya krodhād dravyaṃ vināśya vā
children.translated_text: Where, after causing violence or destroying property out of anger,

children.text: uktaṃ tuṣṭikaraṃ yat tu vidyāt krodhakṛtaṃ tu tat ||
children.translated_text: something conciliatory has been promised, that should be known as made from anger.

children.text: svasthenārtena vā deyaṃ bhāvitaṃ dharmakāraṇāt
children.translated_text: What has been acknowledged as payable by a healthy or afflicted man for the sake of <s>dharma</s>,

children.text: adattvā tu mṛte dāpyas tatsuto nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: if he dies without giving it, his son is to be made to pay; there is no doubt about this.

children.text: nirdhanair anapatyais tu yat kṛtaṃ śauṇḍikādibhiḥ
children.translated_text: What has been incurred by poor men without offspring, such as liquor sellers and the like,

children.text: tatstrīṇām upabhoktā tu dadyāt tadṛṇam eva hi ||
children.translated_text: the man who enjoys those men's women must indeed pay that very debt.

children.text: śauṇḍikavyādhajanakagopanāvikayoṣitām
children.translated_text: For the women of liquor sellers, hunters, janakas, cowherds, and boatmen,

children.text: adhiṣṭhātā ṛṇaṃ dāpyas tāsāṃ bhartṛkriyāsu tat ||
children.translated_text: the man who takes charge of them is to be made to pay the debt connected with their husbands' affairs.

children.text: na ca bhāryākṛtam ṛṇaṃ kathaṃcit patyur ābhavet
children.translated_text: A debt contracted by a wife shall not in any way fall upon her husband,

children.text: āpatkṛtād ṛte puṃsāṃ kuṭumbārthe hi vistaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: except one incurred in emergency; in family matters the extension for men is broad.

children.text: anyatra rajakavyādhagopaśauṇḍikayoṣitām
children.translated_text: This is apart from the wives of washermen, hunters, cowherds, and liquor sellers,

children.text: teṣāṃ tu tatparā vṛttiḥ kuṭumbaṃ ca tadāśrayam ||
children.translated_text: for their livelihood is devoted to that work, and the family depends on it.

children.text: amatenaiva putrasya pradhanā yānyam āśrayet
children.translated_text: If a principal woman, without the son's consent, resorts to another man,

children.text: putreṇaivāpahāryaṃ taddhanaṃ duhitṛbhir vinā ||
children.translated_text: that property is to be recovered by the son alone, not by the daughters.

children.text: ṛṇārtham āharet tantuṃ na sukhārthaṃ kadācana
children.translated_text: One should continue the family line for the sake of discharging debt, never for pleasure.

children.text: ayukte kāraṇe yasmāt pitarau tu na dāpayet ||
children.translated_text: For one should not make the parents pay on an improper ground.

children.text: yā svaputraṃ tu jahyāt strī samartham api putriṇī
children.translated_text: If a woman who has children abandons her own son, though he is capable,

children.text: āhṛtya strīdhanaṃ tatra pitryarṇaṃ śodhayen manuḥ ||
children.translated_text: then, having taken her <s>strīdhana</s> (woman's property), he should clear the paternal debt, says <s>Manu</s>.

children.text: bālaputrādhikārthā ca bhartāraṃ yānyam āśritā
children.translated_text: And if a woman with minor sons, for the sake of greater advantage, has resorted to another husband,

children.text: āśritas tadṛṇaṃ dadyād bālaputrāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the man to whom she resorted should pay that debt; this is remembered as the rule for minor sons.

children.text: dīrghapravāsinirbandhujaḍonmattārtaliṅginām
children.translated_text: For men long abroad, without kinsmen, dull-witted, insane, afflicted, or bearing religious marks,

children.text: jīvatām api dātavyaṃ tatstrīdravyasamāśritaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: even while they are alive, payment must be made by those who rely on those men's women and property.

children.text: vyasanābhiplute putre bālo vā yatna dṛśyate
children.translated_text: When a son is overwhelmed by vice, or is seen to be a minor,

children.text: dravyahṛd dāpyate tatra tasyābhāve purandhrihṛt ||
children.translated_text: the taker of the property is made to pay there; in his absence, the taker of the woman.

children.text: pūrvaṃ dadyād dhanagrāhaḥ putras tasmād anantaram
children.translated_text: First the taker of the property should pay, and after him the son.

children.text: yoṣidgrāhaḥ sutābhāve putro vātyantanirdhanaḥ ||
children.translated_text: In the absence of a son, the taker of the woman should pay, or when the son is utterly poor.

children.text: deyaṃ bhāryākṛtam ṛṇaṃ bhartrā putreṇa mātṛkam
children.translated_text: A debt contracted by a wife is to be paid by the husband, and a mother's debt by the son,

children.text: bhartur arthe kṛtaṃ yat syād abhidhāya gate diśam ||
children.translated_text: when it was incurred for the husband's sake after he had given instructions and gone to another region.

children.text: deyaṃ putrakṛtaṃ tat syād yac ca syād anuvarṇitam
children.translated_text: A debt contracted by a son is payable when it has been expressly approved,

children.text: kṛtāsaṃvāditaṃ yac ca śrutvā caivānucoditam ||
children.translated_text: and also when, after it was done and reported, it was heard and not challenged.

children.text: dhāryo 'varuddhas tv ṛṇikaḥ prakāśaṃ janasaṃsadi
children.translated_text: A debtor may be held under restraint openly in the public assembly,

children.text: yāvan na dadyād deyaṃ ca deśācārasthitir yathā ||
children.translated_text: until he pays what is payable, according to the established local custom.

children.text: viṇmūtraśaṅkā yasya syād dhāryamāṇasya dehinaḥ
children.translated_text: If a living person under restraint has need of feces or urine,

children.text: pṛṣṭhato vānugantavyo nibaddhaṃ vā samutsṛjet ||
children.translated_text: he should be followed from behind, or one may let him go while still bound.

children.text: sa kṛtapratibhūś caiva moktavyaḥ syād dine dine
children.translated_text: If he has furnished a surety, he should be released day by day,

children.text: āhārakāle rātrau ca nibandhe pratibhūḥ sthitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: at mealtime and at night; while he is confined, the surety remains responsible.

children.text: yo darśanapratibhuvaṃ nādhigacchen na cāśrayet
children.translated_text: A man who does not obtain a surety for appearance and does not submit to one,

children.text: sa cārake niroddhavyaḥ sthāpyo vāvedya rakṣiṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: should be confined in a prison, or placed under guard after the guards have been informed.

children.text: na cārake niroddhavya āryaḥ prātyayikaḥ śuciḥ
children.translated_text: A noble, trustworthy, and pure man should not be confined in a prison.

children.text: so 'nibaddhaḥ pramoktavyo nibaddhaḥ śapathena vā ||
children.translated_text: He should be released unbound, or, if bound, on an oath.

children.text: pīḍanenoparodhena sādhayed ṛṇikaṃ dhanī
children.translated_text: A creditor may recover from a debtor by pressure and obstruction,

children.text: karmaṇā vyavahāreṇa sāntvenādau vibhāvitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: after the matter has first been established, through labor, legal procedure, or conciliation.

children.text: ādadītārtham evaṃ tu vyājenācaritena ca
children.translated_text: In this way he may take the property also by a stratagem or by customary practice.

children.text: karmaṇā kṣatraviśśūdrān samahīnāṃś ca dāpayet ||
children.translated_text: He should make Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, Śūdras, and equals or inferiors pay by labor.

children.text: rājānaṃ svāminaṃ vipraṃ sāntvenaiva pradāpayet
children.translated_text: He should make a king, a master, or a Brahmin pay only by conciliation.

children.text: rikthinaṃ suhṛdaṃ vāpi chalenaiva prasādhayet ||
children.translated_text: He should secure the heir, or even a friend, only by a stratagem.

children.text: vaṇijaḥ karṣakāś caiva śilpinaś cābravīd bhṛguḥ
children.translated_text: Merchants, farmers, and artisans too, said <s>Bhṛgu</s>,

children.text: deśācāreṇa dāpyāḥ syur duṣṭān saṃpīḍya dāpayet ||
children.translated_text: should be made to pay according to local custom; he should press the wicked and make them pay.

children.text: pīḍayet tu dhanī yatra ṛṇikaṃ nyāyavādinam
children.translated_text: But where a creditor oppresses a debtor who is pleading according to justice,

children.text: tasmād arthāt sa hīyeta tatsamaṃ cāpnuyād damam ||
children.translated_text: he should lose that sum, and should incur a fine equal to it.

children.text: yadi hy ādāv anādiṣṭam aśubhaṃ karma kārayet
children.translated_text: For if, at the outset, he makes him perform a wrongful act that was not ordered,

children.text: prāpnuyāt sāhasaṃ pūrvam ṛṇān mucyeta carṇikaḥ ||
children.translated_text: he should incur the first <s>sāhasa</s> fine, and the debtor should be released from the debts.

children.text: uddhārādikam ādāya svāmine na dadāti yaḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever takes something such as recovered property and does not give it to the owner,

children.text: sa tasya dāso bhṛtyaḥ strī paśur vā jāyate gṛhe ||
children.translated_text: is born in that owner's house as his slave, servant, wife, or animal.

children.text: trayaproṣitanikṣiptabandhānvāhitayācitam
children.translated_text: What is deposited by one away from home, pledged, consigned, or borrowed,

children.text: vaiśyavṛttyarpitaṃ caiva so 'rthas tūpanidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and what is entrusted for mercantile livelihood: that property is remembered as an <s>upanidhi</s> (trust deposit).

children.text: nikṣiptaṃ yasya yat kiṃcit tatprayatnena pālayet
children.translated_text: Whatever has been deposited with someone, he should guard it with care.

children.text: daivarājakṛtād anyo vināśas tasya kīrtyate ||
children.translated_text: Loss of it is declared to be any loss other than one caused by fate or the king.

children.text: yasya doṣeṇa yat kiṃcid vināśyeta hriyeta vā
children.translated_text: If anything is destroyed or carried off through someone's fault,

children.text: tad dravyaṃ sodayaṃ dāpyo daivarājakṛtād vinā ||
children.translated_text: he is to be made to pay that property with increase, except when it was caused by fate or the king.

children.text: yācitānantaraṃ nāśe daivarājakṛte 'pi saḥ
children.translated_text: If destruction occurs after it has been demanded back, even through fate or royal action,

children.text: grahītā pratidāpyaḥ syān mūlyamātraṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the receiver must repay only its value; there is no doubt.

children.text: nyāsādikaṃ paradravyaṃ prabhakṣitam upekṣitam
children.translated_text: Another's property, such as a <s>nyāsa</s> (deposit), if consumed or neglected,

children.text: ajñānanāśitaṃ caiva yena dāpyaḥ sa eva tat ||
children.translated_text: or if destroyed through ignorance, is to be paid for by that very person who did it.

children.text: bhakṣitaṃ sodayaṃ dāpyaḥ samaṃ dāpya upekṣitam
children.translated_text: What has been consumed is to be paid with increase; what has been neglected is to be paid in equal measure.

children.text: kiṃcin nyūnaṃ pradāpyaḥ syād dravyam ajñānanāśitam ||
children.translated_text: Property destroyed through ignorance should be made good at something less.

children.text: arājadaivikenāpi nikṣiptaṃ yatra nāśitam
children.translated_text: Where a deposit is destroyed even by a cause that is not royal or divine,

children.text: grahītuḥ saha bhāṇḍena dātur naṣṭaṃ tad ucyate ||
children.translated_text: if it is lost together with the receiver's goods, that is said to be the depositor's loss.

children.text: jñātvā dravyaviyogaṃ tu dātā yatra vinikṣipet
children.translated_text: But where the giver deposits it while knowing the risk of separation from the property,

children.text: sarvopāyavināśe 'pi grahītā naiva dāpyate ||
children.translated_text: the receiver is not to be made to pay, even if all means of protection fail.

children.text: grāhakasya hi yad doṣān naṣṭaṃ tu grāhakasya tat
children.translated_text: For what is lost through the receiver's fault is the receiver's responsibility.

children.text: tasmin naṣṭe hṛte vāpi grahītā mūlyam āharet ||
children.translated_text: When it is lost or carried off, the receiver must bring its value.

children.text: grāhyas tūpanidhiḥ kāle kālahīnaṃ tu varjayet
children.translated_text: An <s>upanidhi</s> should be received at the appointed time; one should avoid what is outside the proper time.

children.text: kālahīnaṃ dadaddaṇḍaṃ dviguṇaṃ ca pradāpyate ||
children.translated_text: Giving it at the wrong time, he is made to pay a fine and twice the amount.

children.text: sarveṣūpanidhiṣv ete vidhayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: These rules have been set forth for all trust deposits.

children.text: yaiś ca saṃskriyate nyāso divasaiḥ pariniścitaiḥ
children.translated_text: And when a <s>nyāsa</s> is to be repaired or prepared within a fixed number of days,

children.text: tadūrdhvaṃ sthāpayecchilpī dāpyo daivahate 'pi tat ||
children.translated_text: if the artisan keeps it beyond that, he is liable for it even if it is struck by fate.

children.text: nyāsadoṣād vināśaḥ syācchilpinaṃ tan na dāpayet
children.translated_text: If destruction occurs because of a defect in the deposit, one should not make the artisan pay for it.

children.text: dāpayecchilpidoṣāt tat saṃskārārthaṃ yad arpitam ||
children.translated_text: But one should make him pay for what was entrusted for preparation if the loss was due to the artisan's fault.

children.text: svalpenāpi ca yat karma naṣṭaṃ ced bhṛtakasya tat
children.translated_text: If a hired man's work is lost even through a slight fault, that is his responsibility.

children.text: paryāptaṃ ditsatas tasya vinaśyet tad agṛhṇataḥ ||
children.translated_text: If it perishes when it is complete and he wishes to hand it over, because the other does not take it, the loss is that other's.

children.text: yadi tat kāryam uddiśya kālaṃ pariniyamya vā
children.translated_text: If, with that work in view, or after a time has been fixed,

children.text: yācito 'rdhakṛte tasminn aprāpte na tu dāpyate ||
children.translated_text: it is asked back while half finished and before the time has arrived, he is not to be made to pay.

children.text: prāptakāle kṛte kārye na dadyād yācito 'pi san
children.translated_text: When the time has arrived and the work is done, if he does not give it even when asked,

children.text: tasmin naṣṭe vāpi grahītā mūlyam āharet ||
children.translated_text: then, if it is lost, the receiver must bring its value.

children.text: yācyamāno na dadyād vā dāpyas tat sodayaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: Or, if he does not give when he is being asked, he becomes liable to pay it with increase.

children.text: atha kāryavipattis tu tasyaiva svāmino bhavet
children.translated_text: But a mishap affecting the work belongs to that owner himself.

children.text: aprāpte vai sa kāle tu dāpyas tv ardhakṛte 'pi tat ||
children.translated_text: Yet if he fails before the time, he is liable for it even though it is only half done.

children.text: yo yācitakam ādāya na dadyāt pratiyācitaḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever takes a borrowed article and does not give it back when asked,

children.text: sa nigṛhya balād dāpyo daṇḍyaś ca na dadāti yaḥ ||
children.translated_text: should be restrained and compelled by force to pay; one who does not give is also to be fined.

children.text: anumārgeṇa kāryeṣu anyasmin vacanān mama
children.translated_text: In transactions, when something is given to another on the instruction, 'by my word,

children.text: dadyās tvam iti yo dattaḥ sa ihānvādhir ucyate ||
children.translated_text: you should give it,' that is called <s>anvādhi</s> here.

children.text: asvāmivikrayaṃ dānam ādhiṃ ca vinivartayet ||
children.translated_text: One should set aside a sale by a non-owner, as well as a gift and a pledge.

children.text: abhiyoktā dhanaṃ kuryāt prathamaṃ jñātibhiḥ svakam
children.translated_text: The claimant should first establish the property as his own through his kinsmen.

children.text: paścād ātmaviśuddhyarthaṃ krayaṃ kretā svabandhubhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: Afterwards, for his own clearance, the buyer should establish the purchase through his own relatives.

children.text: nāṣṭikas tu prakurvīta tad dhanaṃ jñātṛbhiḥ svakam
children.translated_text: The person whose property was lost should establish that property as his own through those who know it.

children.text: adattatyaktavikrītaṃ kṛtvā svaṃ labhate dhanam ||
children.translated_text: Having made his own what was not given away, abandoned, or validly sold, he obtains the property.

children.text: prakāśaṃ vā krayaṃ kuryān mūlaṃ vāpi samarpayet
children.translated_text: Or the buyer should make the purchase public, or else produce the original source.

children.text: mūlānayanakālas tu deyo yojanasaṃkhyayā ||
children.translated_text: The time for bringing that source is to be granted according to the number of <s>yojanas</s>.

children.text: prakāśaṃ ca krayaṃ kuryāt sādhubhir jñātibhiḥ svakaiḥ
children.translated_text: He should make the purchase public with good men and with his own kinsmen.

children.text: na tatrānyā kriyā proktā daivikī na ca mānuṣī ||
children.translated_text: No other procedure is prescribed there, neither divine nor human.

children.text: yadā mūlam upanyasya punar vādī krayaṃ vadet
children.translated_text: When, after presenting the source, the litigant again alleges purchase,

children.text: āharen mūlam evāsau na krayeṇa prayojanam ||
children.translated_text: he must produce that source alone; there is no purpose in relying on the purchase.

children.text: asamāhāryamūlas tu krayam eva viśodhayet
children.translated_text: But if the source cannot be brought, he must clear the purchase itself.

children.text: viśodhite kraye rājñā na vaktavyaḥ sa kiṃcana ||
children.translated_text: When the purchase has been cleared before the king, nothing more is to be said to him.

children.text: anupasthāpayan mūlaṃ krayaṃ vāpy aviśodhayan
children.translated_text: If he does not produce the source, or does not clear the purchase,

children.text: yathābhiyogaṃ dhanine dhanaṃ dāpyo damaṃ ca saḥ ||
children.translated_text: he is to be made to pay the property to the owner according to the accusation, along with a fine.

children.text: yadi svaṃ naiva kurute jñātibhir nāṣṭiko dhanam
children.translated_text: If the person whose property was lost does not establish the property as his own through those who know it,

children.text: prasaṅgavinivṛttyarthaṃ coravaddaṇḍam arhati ||
children.translated_text: then, to prevent improper claims, he deserves punishment like a thief.

children.text: vaniṅvīthīparigataṃ vijñātaṃ rājapuruṣaiḥ
children.translated_text: If it has passed through the merchants' street and is known to the king's officers,

children.text: avijñātāśrayāt krītaṃ vikretā yatra vā mṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: or if it was bought from an unknown source, or where the seller has died,

children.text: svāmī dattvārdhamūlyaṃ tu pragṛhṇīta svakaṃ dhanam
children.translated_text: the owner may take back his own property after paying half the value.

children.text: ardhaṃ dvayor apahṛtaṃ tatra syād vyavahārataḥ ||
children.translated_text: In that case, by legal procedure, half the loss belongs to each of the two.

children.text: avijñātakrayo doṣas tathā cāparipālanam
children.translated_text: An unknown purchase is a fault, and so too is failure to protect the property.

children.text: etad dvayaṃ samākhyātaṃ dravyahānikaraṃ buddhaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: These two are declared by the wise to cause loss of property.

children.text: samavetās tu ye kecicchalpino vaṇijo 'pi vā
children.translated_text: Whatever artisans or merchants have joined together,

children.text: avibhajya pṛthagbhūtaiḥ prāptaṃ tatra phalaṃ samam ||
children.translated_text: if they have separated without dividing, the gain obtained there is equal among them.

children.text: bhāṇḍapiṇḍavyayoddhārabhārasārārthavīkṣaṇam
children.translated_text: The inspection and accounting of goods, capital, expenses, receipts, loads, and value

children.text: kuryus te 'vyabhicāreṇa samayena vyavasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: they should carry out without deviation, remaining within their agreement.

children.text: prayogaṃ kurvate ye tu hemadhānyarasādinā
children.translated_text: But those who carry out an investment with gold, grain, liquids, and the like,

children.text: samanyūnādhikair aṃśair lābhas teṣāṃ tathāvidhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: their profit is of that same kind, according as their shares are equal, smaller, or larger.

children.text: bahūnāṃ saṃmato yas tu dadyād eko dhanaṃ naraḥ
children.translated_text: When one man, approved by many, gives money,

children.text: ṛṇaṃ ca kārayed vāpi sarvair eva kṛtaṃ bhavet ||
children.translated_text: or has a debt incurred, it is to be regarded as done by all of them.

children.text: jñātisaṃbandhisuhṛdām ṛṇaṃ deyaṃ sabandhakam
children.translated_text: A debt for kinsmen, relatives, and friends should be given with security,

children.text: anyeṣāṃ lagnakopetaṃ lekhyasākṣiyutaṃ tathā ||
children.translated_text: and for others with a <s>lagnaka</s> (attached bond), together with a document and witnesses.

children.text: svecchādeyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ tu rasā dhānyaṃ ca sāvidhi
children.translated_text: Gold may be given at one's own wish, but liquids and grain according to rule;

children.text: deśasthityā pradātavyaṃ grahītavyaṃ tathaiva ca ||
children.translated_text: according to the local custom it should be given, and likewise received.

children.text: samavetais tu yad dattaṃ prārthanīyaṃ tathaiva tat
children.translated_text: What has been given by persons assembled together is to be demanded in that same way;

children.text: na ca yāceta yaḥ kaścil lābhāt sa parihīyate ||
children.translated_text: and whoever does not make a claim is deprived of the profit.

children.text: corataḥ salilād agner dravyaṃ yas tu samāharet
children.translated_text: Whoever recovers property from a thief, from water, or from fire,

children.text: tasyāṃśo daśamo deyaḥ sarvavādeṣv ayaṃ vidhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: a tenth share is to be given to him; this is the rule in all disputes.

children.text: śikṣakābhijñakuśalā ācāryaś ceti śilpinaḥ
children.translated_text: The instructor, the expert, the skilled worker, and the master are the artisans;

children.text: ekadvitricaturbhāgān hareyus te yathottaram ||
children.translated_text: they should take one, two, three, and four shares respectively, in ascending order.

children.text: pararāṣṭrād dhanaṃ yat syāc cauraiḥ svāmyājñayāhṛtam
children.translated_text: Whatever wealth is brought from another kingdom by thieves at their master's command,

children.text: rājño daśāṃśam uddhṛtya vibhajeran yathāvidhi ||
children.translated_text: after setting aside a tenth for the king, they should divide it according to rule.

children.text: corāṇāṃ mukhyabhūtas tu caturo 'ṃśāṃs tato haret
children.translated_text: The man who is chief among the thieves should then take four shares;

children.text: śūro 'ṃśāṃs trīn samartho dvau śoṣās tv ekaikam eva ca ||
children.translated_text: the brave man three shares, the capable man two, and the rest one each.

children.text: teṣāṃ cet prasṛtānāṃ yo grahaṇaṃ samavāpnuyāt
children.translated_text: If, when they have gone out, one of them is captured,

children.text: tanmokṣaṇārthaṃ yad dattaṃ vaheyus te yathāṃśataḥ ||
children.translated_text: whatever is given for his release they should bear in proportion to their shares.

children.text: nartakānām eṣa eva dharmaḥ sadbhir udāhṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: The good declare this same <s>dharma</s> (rule) for performers,

children.text: tālajño labhate hy ardhaṃ gāyanās tu samāṃśinaḥ
children.translated_text: for the knower of rhythm receives half, while the singers have equal shares;

children.text: pramukhā dvyaṃśam arhanti so 'yaṃ sambhūya kurvatām ||
children.translated_text: the leading performers deserve a double share. This is the rule for those who act jointly.

children.text: vaṇijāṃ karṣakāṇāṃ ca corāṇāṃ śilpināṃ tathā
children.translated_text: For merchants and farmers, for thieves and artisans likewise,

children.text: aniyamyāṃśakartṝṇāṃ sarveṣām eṣa nirṇayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and for all whose shares have not been fixed, this is the decision.

children.text: vikrayaṃ caiva dānaṃ ca na neyāḥ syur anicchavaḥ
children.translated_text: Unwilling wives and sons should not be brought to sale or gift,

children.text: dārāḥ putrāś ca sarvasvam ātmanaiva tu yojayet ||
children.translated_text: nor the whole estate; one should deal only with what belongs to oneself.

children.text: āpatkāle tu kartavyaṃ dānaṃ vikraya eva vā
children.translated_text: But in a time of calamity, a gift or sale may be made;

children.text: anyathā na pravarteta iti śāstraviniścayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: otherwise one should not proceed. This is the settled conclusion of the śāstra.

children.text: sarvasvagṛhavarjaṃ tu kuṭumbabharaṇādhikam
children.translated_text: Excluding the whole estate and the house, and beyond what is needed to support the family,

children.text: yad dravyaṃ tat svakaṃ deyam adeyaṃ syād ato 'nyathā ||
children.translated_text: whatever property there is, that is one's own and may be given; otherwise it is not to be given.

children.text: ataś ca sutadārāṇāṃ vaśitvaṃ tv anuśāsane
children.translated_text: Therefore authority over sons and wives is for discipline and instruction;

children.text: vikraye caiva dāne ca vaśitvaṃ na sute pituḥ ||
children.translated_text: in sale and gift a father's authority over a son does not exist.

children.text: svecchayā yaḥ pratiśrutya brāhmaṇāya pratigraham
children.translated_text: One who, of his own will, has promised a gift to a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>,

children.text: na dadyād ṛṇava dāpyaḥ prāpnuyāt pūrvasāhasam ||
children.translated_text: but does not give it, is to be made to pay as if it were a debt, and incurs the first <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: pratiśrutasyādānena dattasyācchādanena ca
children.translated_text: By not giving what has been promised, and by concealing what has been given,

children.text: kalpakoṭiśataṃ martyas tiryagyonau ca jāyate ||
children.translated_text: a mortal is born in an animal womb for a hundred crores of kalpas.

children.text: avijñātopalabdhyarthaṃ dānaṃ yatra nirūpitam
children.translated_text: Where a payment has been stipulated for the purpose of obtaining what is not yet known,

children.text: upalabdhikriyālabdhaṃ sā bhṛtiḥ parikīrtitā ||
children.translated_text: what is obtained by the act of discovery is called <s>bhṛti</s> (hire or wages).

children.text: bhayatrāṇāya rakṣārthaṃ tathā kāryaprasādhanāt
children.translated_text: For deliverance from fear, for protection, and likewise for the accomplishment of a task,

children.text: anena vidhinā labdhaṃ vidyāt pratyupakārataḥ ||
children.translated_text: what is obtained by this rule should be understood as recompense for a service.

children.text: prāṇasaṃśayam āpannaṃ yo mām uttārayed itaḥ
children.translated_text: If a man in danger of his life says, 'Whoever rescues me from this,

children.text: sarvasvaṃ tasya dāsyāmīty ukte 'pi na tathā bhavet ||
children.translated_text: I will give him all my property,' even when this has been said, it is not to be so.

children.text: kāmakrodhāsvatantrārtaklībonmattapramohitaiḥ
children.translated_text: What is given by those overcome by desire or anger, by persons not independent, distressed, impotent, mad, or deluded,

children.text: vyatyāsaparihāsāc ca yad dattaṃ tat punar haret ||
children.translated_text: or what is given by mistake or in jest, that one should take back.

children.text: yā tu kāryasya siddhyartham utkocā syāt pratiśrutā
children.translated_text: But a <s>utkoca</s> (bribe) that has been promised for the success of a matter,

children.text: tasminn api prasiddhe 'rthe na deyā syāt kathaṃcana ||
children.translated_text: is not to be given in any way, even when that matter has been accomplished.

children.text: atha prāg eva dattā syāt pratidāpyas tathā balāt
children.translated_text: And if it has already been given beforehand, it must likewise be forcibly made to be returned;

children.text: daṇḍaṃ caikādaśaguṇam āhur gārgīyamānavāḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Gārgīyas</s> and <s>Mānavas</s> say that there is also an elevenfold fine.

children.text: stenasāhasikodvṛttapārajāyikaśaṃsanāt
children.translated_text: Through denunciation of a thief, a violent offender, an insolent man, or an adulterer,

children.text: darśanād vṛttanaṣṭasya tathāsatyapravartanāt ||
children.translated_text: through pointing out one who has lost good conduct, and likewise through setting falsehood in motion,

children.text: prāptam etais tu yat kiṃcit tad utkocākhyam ucyate
children.translated_text: whatever is obtained by these means is called <s>utkoca</s> (bribe);

children.text: na dātā tatra daṇḍyaḥ syān madhyasthaś caiva doṣabhāk ||
children.translated_text: the giver should not be punished there, but the intermediary bears fault.

children.text: niyukto yas tu kāryeṣu sa ced utkocam āpnuyāt
children.translated_text: If a man appointed to official tasks receives a <s>utkoca</s> (bribe),

children.text: sa dāpyas taddhanaṃ kṛtsnaṃ damaś caikādaśādhikam ||
children.translated_text: he is to be made to pay all that money, and an additional elevenfold fine.

children.text: aniyuktas tu kāryārtham utkocaṃ yam avāpnuyāt
children.translated_text: But whatever <s>utkoca</s> an unappointed man receives for the sake of a task,

children.text: kṛtapratyupakārārthas tasya doṣo na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: when it is for a reciprocal service already performed, no fault belongs to him.

children.text: svasthenārtena vā dattaṃ śrāvitaṃ dharmakāraṇāt
children.translated_text: What has been given or publicly declared by a healthy or distressed man for the sake of <s>dharma</s>,

children.text: adattvā tu mṛte dāpyas tatsuto nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: if he dies without giving it, his son is to be made to pay it; there is no doubt here.

children.text: yogādhamanavikrītaṃ yogadānapatigraham
children.translated_text: What has been sold through contrivance or oppressive pressure, or a gift or acceptance made through contrivance,

children.text: yasya vāpy upadhiṃ paśyet tat sarvaṃ vinivartayet ||
children.translated_text: or whatever hidden condition or fraud he sees in it, he should annul all of that.

children.text: bhṛtāvaniścitāyāṃ tu daśabhāgam avāpnuyāt
children.translated_text: When wages have not been fixed, they should receive a tenth share

children.text: lābhagovīryasasyānāṃ vaṇiggopakṛṣīvalāḥ ||
children.translated_text: of profit, cattle-increase, and crops: merchants, cowherds, and farmers respectively.

children.text: karmārambhaṃ tu yaḥ kṛtvā siddhaṃ naiva tu kārayet
children.translated_text: A man who has begun a task but does not bring it to completion

children.text: balāt kārayitavyo 'sau akurvan daṇḍam arhati ||
children.translated_text: should be compelled by force; if he does not perform it, he deserves a fine.

children.text: vighnayan vāhako dāpyaḥ prasthāne dviguṇāṃ bhṛtim ||
children.translated_text: A carrier who obstructs departure is to be made to pay twice the hire,

children.text: na tu dāpyo hṛtaṃ corair dagdhamūḍhaṃ jalena vā ||
children.translated_text: but he is not to be made to pay for what has been stolen by thieves, burned, or carried off by water.

children.text: tyajet pathi sahāyaṃ yaḥ śrāntaṃ rogārtam eva vā
children.translated_text: Whoever abandons on the road a companion who is weary or afflicted by illness

children.text: prāpnuyāt sāhasaṃ pūrvaṃ grāme tryaham apālayan ||
children.translated_text: incurs the first <s>sāhasa</s> fine, if he fails to protect him for three days in a village.

children.text: yadā tu pathi tadbhāṇḍam āsidhyeta hriyeta vā
children.translated_text: But when that load is detained on the road or is stolen,

children.text: yāvān adhvā gatas tena prāpnuyāt tāvatīṃ bhṛtim ||
children.translated_text: he receives only as much hire as corresponds to the road he has travelled with it.

children.text: hastyaśvagokharoṣṭrādīn gṛhītvā bhāṭakena yaḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever, having taken elephants, horses, cows, donkeys, camels, and the like on hire,

children.text: nārpayet kṛtakṛtyārthaḥ sa tu dāpyaḥ sabhāṭakam ||
children.translated_text: does not return them after the purpose has been accomplished, is to be made to pay along with the hire.

children.text: gṛhavāryāpaṇādīṇi gṛhītvā bhāṭakena yaḥ
children.translated_text: Whoever, having taken houses, water-rights, shops, and the like on hire,

children.text: svāmine nārpayed yāvat tāvad dāpyaḥ sabhāṭakam ||
children.translated_text: Until he hands it over to the owner, he should be made to pay it together with the hire charge.

children.text: kṣetrārāmavivīteṣu gṛheṣu paśuvāṭiṣu
children.translated_text: In fields, gardens, enclosed preserves, houses, and cattle-pens,

children.text: grahaṇaṃ tatpraviṣṭānāṃ tāḍanaṃ vā bṛhaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: the seizure of animals that have entered them, or their beating, is allowed, says <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: adhamottamamadhyānāṃ paśūnāṃ caiva tāḍane
children.translated_text: In the beating of animals that are low, high, or middling,

children.text: svāmī tu vivaded yatra daṇḍaṃ tatra prakalpayet ||
children.translated_text: where the owner brings a dispute, there one should prescribe a fine.

children.text: ajāteṣv eva sasyeṣu kuryād āvaraṇaṃ mahat
children.translated_text: Before the crops have even sprouted, one should make a strong enclosure;

children.text: duḥkheneha nivāryante labdhasvādurasā mṛgāḥ ||
children.translated_text: for animals that have tasted the sweet flavor are hard to restrain here.

children.text: dāpayet paṇapādaṃ gāṃ dvau pādau mahiṣīṃ tathā
children.translated_text: He should make one pay a quarter-<s>paṇa</s> for a cow, and likewise two quarters for a buffalo cow;

children.text: tathājāvikavatsānāṃ pādo daṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: and for goats, sheep, and calves, a quarter is declared to be the fine.

children.text: samūhināṃ tu yo dharmas tena dharmeṇa te sadā
children.translated_text: The rule that belongs to corporate groups: by that rule they should always

children.text: prakuryuḥ sarvakarmāṇi svadharmeṣu vyavasthitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: carry out all their affairs, abiding in their own established norms.

children.text: avirodhena dharmasya nirgataṃ rājaśāsanam
children.translated_text: A royal edict issued without conflict with <s>dharma</s> (normative order)

children.text: tasyaivācaraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ kartavyaṃ tu nṛpājñayā ||
children.translated_text: must be observed first, by the command of the king.

children.text: rājapravartitān dharmān yo naro nānupālayet
children.translated_text: A man who does not follow the rules promulgated by the king

children.text: garhyaḥ sa pāpo daṇḍyaś ca lopayan rājaśāsanam ||
children.translated_text: is blameworthy, sinful, and punishable, because he annuls the royal decree.

children.text: yuktiyuktaṃ ca yo hanyād vaktur yo 'navakāśadaḥ
children.translated_text: One who rejects what is reasonable, and one who gives no opportunity to a speaker,

children.text: ayuktaṃ caiva yo brūte sa dāpyaḥ pūrvasāhasam ||
children.translated_text: and one who says what is unreasonable, should be made to pay the first <s>sāhasa</s> fine.

children.text: sāhasī bhedakārī ca gaṇadravyavināśakaḥ
children.translated_text: A violent man, a maker of dissension, and a destroyer of corporate property,

children.text: ucchedyāḥ sarva evaite vikhyāpyaivaṃ nṛpe bhṛguḥ ||
children.translated_text: all these should be expelled after public notification, says <s>Bhṛgu</s>.

children.text: ekapātre ca vā paṅktyāṃ saṃbhoktā yasya yo bhavet
children.translated_text: Whoever is to be a person who eats with another from one vessel or in one row,

children.text: akurvaṃs tat tathā daṇḍyas tasya doṣam adarśayan ||
children.translated_text: if he does not do that, and does not show that person's fault, he is to be fined accordingly.

children.text: gaṇam uddiśya yat kiṃcit kṛtvarṇaṃ bhakṣitaṃ bhavet
children.translated_text: Whatever, being set apart for the <s>gaṇa</s> (corporate body), has been consumed,

children.text: ātmārthaṃ viniyuktaṃ vā deyaṃ tair eva tad bhavet ||
children.translated_text: or used for one's own purpose, that must be paid back by those very persons.

children.text: gaṇānāṃ śreṇivargāṇāṃ gatāḥ syur ye tu madhyatām
children.translated_text: Those who have come into membership among <s>gaṇas</s>, guilds, and classes

children.text: prāktanasya dhanarṇasya samāṃśāḥ sarva eva te ||
children.translated_text: all share equally in an earlier debt of money.

children.text: tathaiva bhojyavaibhājyadānadharmakriyāsu ca
children.translated_text: Likewise in matters of common eating, division, gifts, and religious rites,

children.text: samūhastho 'ṃśabhāgī syāt pragatas tv aṃśabhāṅ na tu ||
children.translated_text: one who is in the group has a share, but one who has departed does not have a share.

children.text: yat taiḥ prāptaṃ rakṣitaṃ vā gaṇārthe vā ṛṇaṃ kṛtam
children.translated_text: What has been acquired or protected by them, or what debt has been incurred for the sake of the <s>gaṇa</s>,

children.text: rājaprasādalabdhaṃ ca sarveṣām eva tatsamam ||
children.translated_text: and what has been obtained by the king's favor: all that belongs equally to all of them.

children.text: nānāpaurasamūhas tu naigamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
children.translated_text: A group made up of various townsmen is called a <s>naigama</s>;

children.text: nānāyudhadharā vrātāḥ samavetāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: bands made up of bearers of various weapons are called <s>vrātas</s>.

children.text: samūho vaṇijādīnāṃ pūgaḥ samparikīrtitaḥ
children.translated_text: A group of merchants and the like is called a <s>pūga</s>;

children.text: pravrajyāvasitā ye tu pāṣaṇḍāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: those who are settled in renunciation are called <s>pāṣaṇḍas</s>.

children.text: brāhmaṇānāṃ samūhas tu gaṇaḥ samparikīrtitaḥ
children.translated_text: A group of brahmins is called a <s>gaṇa</s>;

children.text: śilpopajīvino ye tu śilpinaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: those who live by crafts are called artisans.

children.text: ārhatasaugatānāṃ tu samūhaḥ saṅgha ucyate
children.translated_text: A group of <s>Ārhatas</s> and <s>Saugatas</s> is called a <s>saṅgha</s>;

children.text: cāṇḍālaśvapacādīnāṃ samūho gulma ucyate ||
children.translated_text: a group of <s>cāṇḍālas</s>, dog-cookers, and the like is called a <s>gulma</s>.

children.text: gaṇapāṣaṇḍapūgāś ca vrātāś ca śreṇayas tathā
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṇas</s>, <s>pāṣaṇḍas</s>, <s>pūgas</s>, <s>vrātas</s>, and guilds,

children.text: samūhasthāś ca ye cānye vargākhyās te bṛhaspatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: and other people situated in groups are called classes, says <s>Bṛhaspati</s>.

children.text: krītvā prāptaṃ na gṛhṇīyād yo na dadyād adūṣitam
children.translated_text: One who, after buying, does not take what has been obtained, or does not give what is faultless,

children.text: sa mūlyād daśamaṃ bhāgaṃ dattvā svadravyam āpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: should obtain his own property after paying one-tenth of the price.

children.text: aprāpte 'rthakriyākāle kṛte naiva pradāpayet
children.translated_text: When the time for carrying out the transaction has not arrived, even though it has been made, he should not be made to pay;

children.text: evaṃ dharmo daśāhāt tu parato 'nuśayo na tu ||
children.translated_text: this is the rule up to ten days; after that there is no rescission.

children.text: bhūmer daśāhe vikretur āyas tatkretur eva ca
children.translated_text: For land, the seller has ten days, and so does its buyer;

children.text: dvādaśāhaḥ sapiṇḍānām api cālpam ataḥ param ||
children.translated_text: for <s>sapiṇḍa</s> kinsmen there are twelve days, and after this even a slight extension is not allowed.

children.text: krītvānuśayavān paṇyaṃ tyajed dohyādi yo naraḥ
children.translated_text: A man who, after buying merchandise, regrets it and abandons milk-yielding goods and the like,

children.text: aduṣṭam eva kāle tu sa mūlyād daśamaṃ vahet ||
children.translated_text: when they are faultless and within the proper time, should pay one-tenth of the price.

children.text: krītvā gacchann anuśayaṃ krayī hastam upāgate
children.translated_text: When a buyer, having bought and taken delivery into his hand, goes away and then regrets the purchase,

children.text: ṣaḍbhāgaṃ tatra mūlyasya dattvā krītaṃ tyajed budhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the wise man should give up the bought item there after paying one-sixth of the price.

children.text: avijñātaṃ tu yat krītaṃ duṣṭaṃ paścād vibhāvitam
children.translated_text: But what has been bought without being known, and is later determined to be defective,

children.text: krītaṃ tat svāmine deyaṃ kāle ced anyathā na tu ||
children.translated_text: that purchased item should be returned to the owner if it is within the time; otherwise not.

children.text: nirdoṣaṃ darśayitvā tu yaḥ sadoṣaṃ prayacchati
children.translated_text: One who, after showing something faultless, gives something defective

children.text: mūlyaṃ taddviguṇaṃ dāpyo vinayaṃ tāvad eva ca ||
children.translated_text: is to be made to pay twice that price, and a disciplinary fine of the same amount.

children.text: upahanyeta vā paṇyaṃ dahyetāpahriyeta vā
children.translated_text: If the merchandise is damaged, burned, or stolen,

children.text: vikretur eva so 'nartho vikrīyāsaṃprayacchataḥ ||
children.translated_text: that loss belongs to the seller alone, when he has sold it but does not hand it over.

children.text: dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇāti krītapaṇyaṃ ca yaḥ krayī
children.translated_text: When a buyer does not accept purchased merchandise that is being handed over,

children.text: vikrītaṃ ca tad anyatra vikretā nāparādhnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: and it is then sold elsewhere, the seller commits no offense.

children.text: mattonmattena vikrītaṃ hīnamūlyaṃ bhayena vā
children.translated_text: What has been sold by one drunk or insane, at too low a price, or through fear,

children.text: asvatantreṇa mugdhena tyājyaṃ tasya punar bhavet ||
children.translated_text: or by one not independent or by a simpleton, must be annulled and become his again.

children.text: tryahaṃ dohyaṃ parīkṣeta pañcāhād vāhyam eva tu
children.translated_text: One should examine a milch animal for three days, and a draft animal for five days;

children.text: muktāvajrapravālānāṃ saptāhaṃ syāt pravīkṣaṇam ||
children.translated_text: for pearls, diamonds, and coral, the inspection period is seven days.

children.text: dvipadām ardhamāsaṃ tu puṃsāṃ taddviguṇaṃ striyāḥ
children.translated_text: For male bipeds it is half a month; for women, twice that.

children.text: daśāhaṃ sarvabījānām ekāhaṃ lohavāsasām ||
children.translated_text: For all seeds it is ten days; for metals and garments, one day.

children.text: ato 'rvākpaṇyadoṣas tu yadi saṃjāyate kvacit
children.translated_text: If a defect in the merchandise arises anywhere before these limits,

children.text: vikretuḥ pratideyaṃ tat kretā mūlyam avāpnuyāt ||
children.translated_text: it must be returned to the seller, and the buyer should recover the price.

children.text: paribhuktaṃ tu yad vāsaḥ kliṣṭarūpaṃ malīmasam
children.translated_text: But a garment that has been used, with its appearance worn and dirty,

children.text: sadoṣam api tat krītaṃ vikretur na bhavet punaḥ ||
children.translated_text: even if it was bought with a defect, does not go back to the seller.

children.text: sādhāraṇaṃ tu yat krītaṃ naiko dadyān narādhamaḥ
children.translated_text: But what has been bought in common, one contemptible man must not give away alone;

children.text: nādadyān na ca gṛhṇīyād vikrīyāc ca na caiva hi ||
children.translated_text: he must not hand it over, nor take it, nor indeed sell it.

children.text: krītvā mūlyena yat paṇyaṃ duṣkrītaṃ manyate krayī
children.translated_text: When the buyer, after buying merchandise for a price, thinks that it was a bad purchase,

children.text: vikretuḥ pratideyaṃ tat tasminn evāhnyavīkṣitam ||
children.translated_text: that item, if unexamined, should be returned to the seller on that very day.

children.text: dvitīye 'hni dadat kretā mūlyāt tryaṃśāṃśam āharet
children.translated_text: When returning it on the second day, the buyer should forfeit a thirtieth part of the price;

children.text: dviguṇaṃ tṛtīye 'hni parataḥ kretur eva tat ||
children.translated_text: on the third day, twice that; after that, it belongs to the buyer alone.

children.text: dravyasvaṃ pañcadhā kṛtvā tribhāgo mūlyam ucyate
children.translated_text: When the intrinsic value of the article has been divided into five, three parts are said to be the price.

children.text: lābhaś caturtho bhāgaḥ syāt pañcamaḥ satyam ucyate ||
children.translated_text: The gain should be a fourth part; a fifth is said to be valid.

children.text: sandhiś ca parivṛttiś ca viṣamā vā tribhogataḥ
children.translated_text: A settlement, an exchange, or an unequal transaction involving three enjoyments,

children.text: ājñayāpi krayaś cāpi daśābdaṃ vinivartayet ||
children.translated_text: and also a purchase made by authorization, should be rescinded within ten years.

children.text: jñātyādīn ananujñāpya samīpasthānaninditān
children.translated_text: If one has not obtained the consent of kinsmen and the others, of nearby, resident, and unimpeached persons,

children.text: krayavikrayadharmo 'pi bhūmer nāstīti nirṇayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: then even the legal validity of buying and selling land does not exist: this is the decision.

children.text: svagrāme daśarātraṃ syād anyagrāme tripakṣakam
children.translated_text: In one's own village the period is ten nights, in another village three fortnights;

children.text: rāṣṭrāntareṣu ṣaṇmāsaṃ bhāṣābhede tu vatsaram ||
children.translated_text: in other kingdoms it is six months, but where the language differs it is a year.

children.text: palāyite tu karade karapratibhuvā saha
