children.text: dyūtaṃ naiva tu seveta krodhalobhavivardhakam
children.translated_text: One should not indulge in gambling, which increases anger and greed,

children.text: asādhujananaṃ krūraṃ narāṇāṃ dravyanāśanam ||
children.translated_text: which gives rise to bad men, is cruel, and destroys men's property.

children.text: dhruvaṃ dyūtāt kalir yasmād viṣaṃ sarpamukhād iva
children.translated_text: Since discord surely comes from gambling, like poison from a snake's mouth,

children.text: tasmād rājā nivarteta viṣaye vyasanaṃ hi tat ||
children.translated_text: therefore the king should suppress that vice in his realm.

children.text: varteta cet prakāśaṃ tu dvārāvasthitatoraṇam
children.translated_text: But if gambling is to take place openly, with a doorway and gateway established,

children.text: asaṃmohārtham āryāṇāṃ kārayet tat karapadam ||
children.translated_text: he should make it a taxable station, so that respectable men are not deceived.

children.text: sabhikaḥ kārayed dyūtaṃ deyaṃ dadyāt svayaṃ nṛpe
children.translated_text: The <s>sabhika</s> (gambling-house supervisor) should conduct the gambling and himself pay what is due to the king;

children.text: daśakaṃ tu śate vṛddhiṃ gṛhṇīyāc ca parājayāt ||
children.translated_text: and from the loser's loss he should take an increase of ten per hundred.

children.text: jetur dadyāt svakaṃ dravyaṃ jitād grāhyaṃ tripakṣakam
children.translated_text: He should give the winner his own stake; from the loser the <s>tripakṣaka</s> should be collected,

children.text: sadyo vā sabhikenaiva kitāvāt tu na saṃśayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: or the <s>sabhika</s> himself should collect it at once from the <s>kitava</s> (gambler), without doubt.

children.text: ekarūpā dvirūpā vā dyūte yasyākṣadevinaḥ
children.translated_text: In gambling, whether a dice-player's dice are marked alike or differently,

children.text: dṛśyate ca jayas tasya yasmin rakṣā vyavasthitā ||
children.translated_text: his victory is recognized when the safeguard has been properly arranged.

children.text: athavā kitavo rājñe dattvā bhāgaṃ yathoditam
children.translated_text: Alternatively, a <s>kitava</s>, having given the king his share as prescribed,

children.text: prakāśaṃ devanaṃ kuryād evaṃ doṣo na vidyate ||
children.translated_text: may play openly; in this way there is no offense.

children.text: prasahya dāpayed deyaṃ tasmin sthāne na cānyathā
children.translated_text: He should compel payment of what is due in that place, and not otherwise;

children.text: jitaṃ vai sabhikas tatra sabhikapratyayā kriyā ||
children.translated_text: there the <s>sabhika</s> controls what has been won, and the action rests on the <s>sabhika</s>'s attestation.

children.text: anabhijño jito mocyo 'mocyo 'bhijño jito rahaḥ
children.translated_text: An ignorant man who has lost should be released; an experienced man, having lost in secret, should not be released.

children.text: sarvasve vijite 'bhijñe na sarvasvaṃ pradāpayet ||
children.translated_text: If an experienced man has lost all his property, one should not make him pay all of it.

children.text: vigrahe 'tha jaye lābhe karaṇe kūṭadevinām
children.translated_text: In disputes, wins, profits, and transactions involving fraudulent gamblers,

children.text: pramāṇaṃ sabhikas tatra śuciś ca sabhiko yadi ||
children.translated_text: the <s>sabhika</s> is the authority there, provided the <s>sabhika</s> is honest.

children.text: mlecchaśvapākadhūrtānāṃ kitavānāṃ tapasvinām
children.translated_text: For <s>mlecchas</s>, <s>śvapākas</s>, rogues, gamblers, ascetics,

children.text: tatkṛtācāram etṝṇāṃ niścayo na tu rājani ||
children.translated_text: and those who follow customs made by them, the settlement does not rest with the king.

children.text: pūrvoktād uktaśeṣaṃ syād adhikāracyutaṃ ca yat
children.translated_text: What is left to be said after what was previously stated, and what has fallen outside its section,

children.text: āhṛtya paratantrārhtanibaddham asamañjasam ||
children.translated_text: what is brought in, dependent on another topic, bound to another meaning, or incoherent,

children.text: dṛṣṭāntatvena śāstrānte punar uktakriyāsthitam
children.translated_text: what stands at the end of a treatise as an example, or as a repeated procedure,

children.text: anena vidhinā yac ca vākyaṃ tat syāt prakīrṇakam ||
children.translated_text: whatever statement is of this kind is a <s>prakīrṇaka</s> (miscellaneous matter).

children.text: rājadharmān svadharmāṃś ca saṃdigdhānāṃ ca bhāṣaṇam
children.translated_text: Royal duties, personal duties, and discussion of doubtful matters,

children.text: pūrvoktād uktaśeṣaṃ ca sarvaṃ tat syāt prakīrṇakam ||
children.translated_text: and what remains after what was previously stated: all that is a <s>prakīrṇaka</s>.

children.text: sadbhāgakaraśulkaṃ ca garte deyaṃ tathaiva ca
children.translated_text: The proper share, tax, and customs duty, and likewise what is payable in a pit or mine,

children.text: saṃgrāmacaurabhedī ca paradārābhimardanam ||
children.translated_text: betrayal in battle, theft, and violation of another's wife,

children.text: gobrāhmaṇajighāṃsā ca śasyavyāghātakṛt tathā
children.translated_text: intent to kill cows or Brahmins, and likewise one who damages crops:

children.text: etān daśāparādhāṃs tu nṛpatiḥ svayam anviṣet ||
children.translated_text: these ten offenses the king should investigate personally.

children.text: niṣkṛtīnām akaraṇam ājñāsedhavyatikramaḥ
children.translated_text: Failure to perform expiations, violation of commands and prohibitions,

children.text: varṇāśramavilopaś ca prarṇasaṅkaralopanam ||
children.translated_text: collapse of the <s>varṇa</s> and <s>āśrama</s> order, and disruption through mixture of <s>varṇas</s>,

children.text: nidhir niṣphalavittaṃ ca daridrasya dhanāgamaḥ
children.translated_text: treasure trove, useless wealth, and the acquisition of wealth by a poor man:

children.text: etāṃś cāraiḥ suviditān svayaṃ rājā nivārayet ||
children.translated_text: when these are well known through spies, the king should stop them himself.

children.text: anāmnā tāni kāryāṇi kriyāvādāṃś ca vādinām
children.translated_text: Those unnamed cases, and the procedural claims of litigants,

children.text: prakṛtīnāṃ prakopaś ca saṅketaś ca parasparam ||
children.translated_text: A revolt of the subjects, and mutual conspiracy among them,

children.text: aśāstravihitaṃ yac ca prajāyāṃ sampravartate
children.translated_text: and whatever is not prescribed by <s>śāstra</s> (authoritative teaching) comes into practice among the people,

children.text: upāyaiḥ sāmabhedād yair etāni śamaye nṛpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the king should pacify these by such means as conciliation and sowing dissension.

children.text: mitrādiṣu prayuñjīta vāgdaṇḍaṃ dhik tapasvini
children.translated_text: Among friends and the like he should apply verbal punishment: 'Fie, ascetic woman!'

children.text: yathoktaṃ tasya tat kuryād anuktaṃ sādhu kalpitam ||
children.translated_text: He should do for that person what has been stated; what has not been stated should be fittingly devised.

children.text: pramāṇena tu kūṭena mudrayā vāpi kūṭayā
children.translated_text: But whoever accomplishes a legal matter by false evidence or by a forged seal,

children.text: kāryaṃ tu sādhayed yo vai sa dāpyo damam uttamam ||
children.translated_text: he should be made to pay the highest fine.

children.text: rājakrīḍāsu ye saktā rājavṛttyupajīvinaḥ
children.translated_text: Those who are attached to the king's amusements and live on royal maintenance,

children.text: apriyasya ca yo vaktā vadhaṃ teṣāṃ pravartayet ||
children.translated_text: and one who speaks what is displeasing: he should proceed with execution for them.

children.text: pratirūpasya kartāraḥ prekṣakāḥ prakarāś ca ye
children.translated_text: Those who make counterfeits, those who watch, and whatever accomplices there are,

children.text: rājārthamoṣakāś caiva prāpnuyur vividhaṃ vadham ||
children.translated_text: and those who steal the king's property, should receive various forms of capital punishment.

children.text: pravrajyāvasitaṃ śūdraṃ japahomaparaṃ tathā
children.translated_text: A <s>śūdra</s> who has taken up renunciation, and likewise one devoted to muttering prayers and fire-offerings,

children.text: vadhena śāsayet pāpaṃ daṇḍyo vā dviguṇaṃ damam ||
children.translated_text: that sinner should be punished with death, or else fined a double fine.

children.text: sacihnam api pāpaṃ tu pṛcchet pāpasya kāraṇam
children.translated_text: Even when a sinner bears a mark of guilt, one should ask the cause of the offense;

children.text: tadā daṇḍaṃ prakalpeta doṣam āropya yatnataḥ ||
children.translated_text: then one should prescribe the punishment, carefully establishing the fault.

children.text: sadvṛttānām tu sarveṣām aparādho yadā bhavet
children.translated_text: But when an offense occurs among any people of good conduct,

children.text: avaśenaiva daivāt tu tatra daṇḍaṃ na kalpayet ||
children.translated_text: helplessly and only by fate, no punishment should be prescribed there.

children.text: samyagdaṇḍapraṇetāro nṛpāḥ pūjyāḥ surair api
children.translated_text: Kings who administer punishment correctly are worthy of honor even from the gods.

children.text: ārambhe pradhamaṃ dadyāt pravṛttau madhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ
children.translated_text: At the beginning he should impose the first fine; when the action is underway, the middle fine is prescribed.

children.text: yasya yo vihito daṇḍaḥ paryāptasya sa vai bhavet ||
children.translated_text: When it has been completed, whatever punishment is prescribed for it should indeed apply.

children.text: rājāno mantriṇaś caiva viśeṣād evam āpnuyuḥ
children.translated_text: Kings and ministers in particular incur it in this way,

children.text: aśāsanāt tu pāpānāṃ natānāṃ daṇḍadhāraṇāt ||
children.translated_text: by failing to punish the wicked and by wielding punishment against the submissive.

children.text: paratantrāś ca ye kecid dāsatvaṃ ye ca saṃsthitāḥ
children.translated_text: Those who are dependent on another, and those who are established in servitude,

children.text: anāthās te tu nirdiṣṭās teṣāṃ daṇḍas tu tāḍanam ||
children.translated_text: are declared to be without independent protection; for them the punishment is beating.

children.text: tāḍanaṃ bandhanaṃ caiva tathaiva ca viḍambanam
children.translated_text: Beating, confinement, and likewise public humiliation:

children.text: eṣa daṇḍo hi dāsasya nārthadaṇḍo vidhīyate ||
children.translated_text: this indeed is the punishment of a slave; a monetary fine is not prescribed.

children.text: suvarṇaśatam ekaṃ tu vadhārho daṇḍam arhati
children.translated_text: One who deserves death is liable to a fine of one hundred <s>suvarṇas</s> (gold coins);

children.text: aṅgacchede tadardhaṃ tu vivāse pañcaviṃśatim ||
children.translated_text: for mutilation of a limb, half of that; for banishment, twenty-five.

children.text: kulīnāryaviśiṣṭeṣu nikṛṣṭeṣv anusārataḥ
children.translated_text: In the case of those of good family, noble persons, distinguished persons, and the lowly, it should follow their status;

children.text: sarvasvaṃ vā nigṛhyaitān purāt śīghraṃ pravāsayet ||
children.translated_text: or, after seizing all their property, he should quickly banish them from the city.

children.text: nirdhanā bandhane sthāpyā vadhaṃ naiva pravartayet
children.translated_text: The penniless should be placed in confinement; he should not proceed to execution.

children.text: sarveṣāṃ pāpayuktānāṃ viśeṣārthaś ca śāstrataḥ ||
children.translated_text: For all who are connected with sin, there is also a special rule according to <s>śāstra</s>.

children.text: vadhāṅgacchedārhavipro niḥsaṅge bandhane viśet
children.translated_text: A Brahmin who deserves death or mutilation of a limb should enter confinement without fetters;

children.text: tadakarmaviyuto 'sau vṛttas tasya damo hi saḥ ||
children.translated_text: excluded from that act and way of life, that indeed is his punishment.

children.text: kūṭasākṣy api nirvāsyo vikhyāpyo 'satpratigrahī
children.translated_text: A false witness too should be banished; one who accepts improper gifts should be publicly proclaimed.

children.text: aṅgacchedī viyojyaḥ syāt svadharme bandhanena tu ||
children.translated_text: One who cuts off a limb should be separated; in respect to his own <s>dharma</s>, punishment is by confinement.

children.text: etaiḥ samāparādhānāṃ tatrāpy evaṃ prakalpayet
children.translated_text: For those whose offenses are equal to these, he should prescribe punishment in this same way there also.

children.text: bālavṛddhāturastrīṇāṃ na daṇḍas tāḍanaṃ damaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For children, the elderly, the sick, and women, the punishment is not a fine but beating.

children.text: strīdhanaṃ dāpayed daṇḍaṃ dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ
children.translated_text: A righteous lord of the earth should make a woman pay a fine from her <s>strīdhana</s> (woman's property);

children.text: nirdhanā prāptadoṣā strī tāḍanaṃ daṇḍam arhati ||
children.translated_text: a penniless woman who has incurred guilt deserves beating as punishment.

children.text: anyāyopārjitaṃ nyastaṃ kośe kośaṃ niveśayet
children.translated_text: What has been acquired unjustly and deposited should be placed in the treasury as treasury property.

children.text: kāryārthe kāryanāśaḥ syād buddhimān nopapātayet ||
children.translated_text: If a legal matter is pursued for wealth, the matter may be ruined; a wise man should not bring that about.

children.text: dattvā dhanaṃ tad viprebhyaḥ sarvaṃ daṇḍasamutthitam
children.translated_text: After giving to Brahmins all that wealth which has arisen from fines,

children.text: putre rājyaṃ samāsajya kurvīta prāyaṇaṃ vane ||
children.translated_text: and after entrusting the kingdom to his son, he should undertake the journey to the forest.

children.text: evaṃ caret sadā yukto rājā dharmeṣu pārthivaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus the king, the ruler, should always act while devoted to <s>dharma</s>,

children.text: hiteṣu caiva lokasya sarvān bhṛtyān niyojayet ||
children.translated_text: and he should appoint all his servants to what is beneficial for the world.
